input.title: Aventon CurrentADV
input.descriptionHtml:
Aventon Current ADV full-suspension eMTB - Ultro X mid-drive motor, RockShox Psylo Gold fork, RockShox Deluxe Select+ shock, SRAM DB8 brakes & Eagle 70 transmission. Real trail performance, available

Aventon Current ADV
Full-Suspension eMTB

 

The Aventon Current ADV is a full-suspension eMTB built around the same platform and Ultro X mid-drive motor as the Current EXP, delivering 110Nm of torque (120Nm in Boost Mode) and up to 105 miles of range from an 800Wh integrated battery. The geometry is trail-specific - 64.6 head angle, 76.6 seat tube angle, 445mm chainstays, and 29" wheels - keeping the bike planted and confident on descents while staying efficient on climbs. The ADV brings this capability at a more accessible price point through a full 6061 aluminum frame and a step-down suspension and brake spec, while sharing the same motor, battery, smart features, and drivetrain cassette as the EXP.

The connected platform delivers 4G/GPS tracking, anti-theft, Air Time tracking, Wheel Lift Control, Overrun, Auto Assist Mode, and a customizable integrated touchscreen display - all managed through the Aventon app with over-the-air updates. Note: 4G connectivity is complimentary for the first year; a paid subscription is required after that period.

E-Bikes are subject to a $160 assembly & tuning fee

The Current ADV is a special order item at Quest Watersports - we don't stock it on the floor, but we can get one for you. Lead time is typically 1-2 weeks subject to Aventon's inventory. Let us order one for you today - call 815.433.2200 or email contact@questwatersports.com.

Sizing:

  • Small - under 5'3"
  • Medium - 5'3" to 5'7"
  • Large - 5'7" to 6'1"
  • Extra Large - over 6'1"
 

Key components:

  • RockShox Psylo Gold fork - 150mm travel, 44mm offset
  • RockShox Deluxe Select+ rear shock - 210x55mm, 140mm rear travel
  • XFusion Manic dropper seatpost - 150mm (S/M) / 170mm (L/XL)
  • SRAM DB8 Stealth hydraulic disc brakes - SRAM Centerline 200mm rotors
  • SRAM Eagle 70 Transmission 12-speed
  • SRAM 34T chainring - SRAM XS-1270 T-Type 10-52T cassette
  • Maxxis Minion DHF 29x2.5" EXO front / Maxxis Minion DHR II 29x2.4" EXO rear - tubeless ready
  • 6061 Aluminum ISIS splined 160mm crankset
